data.summary: The Landkreis Musteruckermark – Bußgeldstelle issued a fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) against Ronny Musterspree for running a red light on 17 October 2026 in Musterprenzlau, recording 1 point and setting a total of €232.00 (fine, fee and delivery costs). An objection (Einspruch) can be filed within two weeks of delivery, which took place on 24 November 2026.
data.explanation: This is an official fine notice (Bußgeldbescheid) for a traffic offense (running a red light) involving your car with plate UM-RS 404. It records 1 point in the driving register and sets a total amount of €232.00 (fine, fee and delivery costs). You may decide whether to object (Einspruch) in writing or on record with the Bußgeldstelle — the app shows until when. If you do nothing by then, the notice becomes final and the amount becomes due two weeks after that. If you disagree with the facts, consider getting advice from a traffic-law lawyer before the deadline.
